properties.description: Built 2026-10-20 (core.yaml statement_kind on Requirement and Constraint; inference.rs STATEMENT_KINDS, attack_reading, is_taken_as_given). An objection reads by how it stands against what it attacks (stands, refutes, answered, conceded); a reply reads answers, stands or concedes; an unstated premise is made explicit and not taken as given unless it says so; a rule of method is taken as given by default. Widening only: the schema stamp moves.
properties.name: statement_kind says objection, reply, unstated premise or rule of method, and each reads accordingly
